name: Launch Items
description: RAMP checklist tasks and assets under human review

agentPrompts.label: Review and approve a launch asset
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-launch` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then walk me through the item I name — its draft, readiness, and risk — and write my decision (approve, request changes, or block) with a review note directly onto that record. Never treat a public submission or press pitch as sent just because it was approved here; sending happens separately, only after approval.

agentPrompts.label: Assemble the RAMP checklist from my launch material
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-launch` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then read the product docs, positioning notes, and target date I give you, and write RAMP checklist items — phase, per-item readiness (SHIP/FIX/BLOCK), proposed action, and an editable draft for each asset or submission.

agentPrompts.label: What's blocking the launch right now?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-launch` skill in this folder, then list the items marked BLOCK and FIX across all phases, with their reason, so I know what has to clear before we can ship.

agentPrompts.label: Show the checklist by RAMP phase
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-launch` skill in this folder, then show the checklist grouped by phase — Research, Assemble, Mobilize, Prove — with each item's status, readiness, and owner.
